message.content:
An editorial illustration displays a two-story orange building floating in a dark, star-filled space. The structure is depicted as an optical illusion: a figure in a white tunic and dark vest falls towards a corrugated metal roof that is oriented downwards, while on the "top" roof, a similarly dressed figure runs past a satellite dish.

On one side, a person leans from a window above hanging laundry and an air conditioning unit. Another side shows black-clad figures in tactical gear entering a window. A red patterned rug hangs over a balcony where a person with a black head covering watches. A small poster with a face and a red flower is affixed to an exterior wall. A potted plant, a black bag, and cardboard boxes also cling to various surfaces.

The masthead "TEMPO" is at the top. Text in Indonesian includes "SETELAH TALIBAN MENANG," "CERUK PASAR GAME LOKAL," and "PENCURIAN IKAN DI LAUT NATUNA." The date "30 AGUSTUS-5 SEPTEMBER 2021" and a barcode are visible in the bottom left corner.
